Pixel OS v2.1.5 — Pure Retail Google PixelOS Stable Update for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Goodix G3 Optical UDFPS Registration & Unlock Fix: fixed Android 17 HidlFingerprintSensorConfig sensorType=0 (TYPE_UNKNOWN) -> 3 (TYPE_UDFPS_OPTICAL) + halControlsIllumination=true in services.jar, started vendor.cdsprpcd CDSP FastRPC daemon for libhvx_proxy_stub.so feature extraction, and granted SELinux vendor_firmware_file + vendor_hal_dspmanager_client + hal_cryptoeng_client permissions
• Double-Tap Home Screen to Lock Fix: moved Home Screen double-tap sleep from raw touchpanel coordinate polling to WindowManager Session.sendWallpaperCommand('android.wallpaper.tap') so typing/scrolling never triggers accidental screen locks while Status Bar & Lock Screen double-tap to sleep remain active
• Developer Options Force-Close Fix: granted system_app / platform_app SELinux property_service set permissions for logpersistd_logging_prop and debug/logd properties
• Compact Wireless Patch OTA (~40 MiB) + Dual EXT4/F2FS /data + 4K60 Gyro-EIS3 GCam 9.6 + Pure Google PixelOS Stable Experience
